messages.content: Good morning David, I hope you're doing well. Let's get started with our daily standup. Can you tell me what you worked on yesterday and if you completed what you had planned?

PROJ-113 is now in In Development status. Let's move on to PROJ-114. What is the current status of PROJ-114, and what percentage complete do you think it will be by the end of the day, and are there any dependencies for this ticket?

There are no blockers preventing your progress. Let's discuss the overall sprint health. Do you believe you will be able to complete all of your assigned tickets, including PROJ-113, PROJ-114, and PROJ-115, by the end of the sprint?

You have concerns about completing all of your assigned tickets by the end of the sprint. Since it's the first day of the sprint, there's no previous day to follow up on. I will flag the potential sprint health issue for further discussion. Good morning David, our standup is now complete.
